hints.title: Prefix Bitwise Difference
hints.text: Bitwise xor has an inverse property: x ^ x = 0. Build a prefix table of cumulative bitwise operations.

hints.title: Prefix Array Construction
hints.text: Let pref[i + 1] = pref[i] ^ arr[i] with pref[0] = 0.

hints.title: Constant Time Range Answer
hints.text: The range query for interval [L, R] evaluates to pref[R + 1] ^ pref[L].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through each query range naively takes O(N * Q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix table construction in O(N) allows each query to be answered in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies prefix xor range reduction analogous to prefix sums.
complexity.notes: Can even compute prefix table in-place in arr if input modification is allowed.
